pages.text: $(l)Alchemy laboratories$()$(br)Scattered over plains, forests, deserts, badlands, snowy plains, taigas, jungles and swamps, looking different in each. Their chests hold materials and sometimes recipes.$(br2)$(l)Alchemist's cottage$()$(br)Forests, taigas and swamps; a basic altar in the cellar.

$(li)$(l)Abandoned workshop$(): buried underground, with affixed guards.$(li)$(l)Stargazer tower$(): mountains.$(li)$(l)Nether forge$(): basalt deltas and crimson forests.$(li)$(l)Primordial sanctum$(): floating ruins on the outer End islands, guarded by the primordial guardian.$(li)$(l)Wandering alchemist's camp$(): plains, savannas, forests, deserts.
